run_interactive_marker_teleop: run the interactive marker ROS node to teleoperate a Stretch robot via 6-DOF marker controls
create_6dof_marker: create a 6-DOF interactive marker with rotate and move axis controls for robot teleoperation
record_robot_demonstration: record a robot demonstration as HDF5 keyframes with RGB and depth images during interactive teleoperation
process_interactive_marker_feedback: process interactive marker feedback events including pose updates, menu selects, and button clicks
move_robot_to_marker_pose: command the Stretch robot to move its arm to the current interactive marker pose using inverse kinematics
